notes: Canonical ruleset the pipeline reads. Generated from the raw pull; do not hand-edit — edit in Airtable and re-run build_ruleset.py.
thresholds_status from Airtable (Draft/Calibrated/Not Applicable). Numbers in measurable_signal are RECOMMENDATIONS, not rules, until a row is Calibrated. No verdicts are produced here.
judge/proxy_only/skip derived from measurable_by_pose. pose_landmarks tokens validated against CONTROLLED_VOCAB (landmark_derivations.py).
phase / phase_order (where present) name the phase a measurement belongs to and its position in the required sequence — the order is itself coached.

records.name: QB - Bootleg - Ball Carriage
records.ideal_execution_standard: Carry the football with two hands at chest height, elbows relaxed, forearms close to the torso, ball protected within the body's frame, off-hand securing the front half until the throwing motion begins.
records.fault_trigger: Ball carried loose/low, elbows flared, or off-hand not securing during the movement. (Ball Position needs ball tracking.)
records.measurable_signal: [DRAFT — PROXY] Carry the ball two-handed at chest height, elbows relaxed, forearms close, ball protected within the body frame, off-hand securing the front until the throwing motion. POSE PROXY = hands-together/height/elbow-tuck; Ball Position needs BALL TRACKING. FORMATION-INDEPENDENT.

records.name: QB - Bootleg - Ball Security
records.ideal_execution_standard: Maintain two-hand control throughout the fake and rollout — keep the football tight to the body until entering the throwing sequence.
records.fault_trigger: Ball drops to one hand or is exposed away from the body during fake/rollout. (Ball Position needs ball tracking.)
records.measurable_signal: [DRAFT — PROXY] Two-hand control throughout the fake + rollout; ball tight to the body until the throwing sequence (cross-cutting Ball Security). POSE PROXY = hands-together/high; FULL confirmation needs BALL TRACKING. Partial. FORMATION-INDEPENDENT.

records.name: QB - Bootleg - Footwork
records.ideal_execution_standard: Maintain efficient, controlled, purposeful steps from the play fake into the rollout — proper stride length, balance, and timing without wasted movement or unnecessary crossover steps.
records.fault_trigger: Wasted/choppy steps, unnecessary crossovers, or poor stride/balance from fake into rollout.
records.measurable_signal: [DRAFT] Efficient, controlled steps from the play fake into the rollout — proper stride length, balance, timing, no wasted or unnecessary crossover steps. Footwork efficiency + step/crossing detection measurable from pose. FORMATION-INDEPENDENT.

records.name: QB - Bootleg - Head / Eyes
records.ideal_execution_standard: Maintain proper head position and eye discipline — sell the run before transitioning vision quickly to the defensive read and receiver progression.
records.fault_trigger: Head/eyes give away the fake or fail to transition to the read. (Eye gaze/reads not pose-measurable — deferred.)
records.measurable_signal: [DRAFT — PARTIAL] Proper head position + eye discipline — sell the run, then transition vision quickly to the read/receiver progression. Head ORIENTATION measurable; actual EYE gaze/reads = deferred. Partial. FORMATION-INDEPENDENT.

records.name: QB - Bootleg - Hip Alignment
records.ideal_execution_standard: Keep hips underneath the body during movement, rotating efficiently through the throw without opening early or losing lower-body power.
records.fault_trigger: Hips over-open early or drift out from under the body, losing rotational power.
records.measurable_signal: [DRAFT] Keep hips underneath the body during movement; rotate efficiently through the throw without opening early or losing lower-body power. Hip-line + rotation timing measurable from pose. FORMATION-INDEPENDENT.

records.name: QB - Bootleg - Initial Ball Security
records.ideal_execution_standard: Immediately after the snap, secure the football with both hands against the chest before beginning the fake or rollout — throwing hand controls the back half, off-hand the front, elbows close to protect it.
records.fault_trigger: Begins the fake/rollout before securing two-hand control, or carries the ball loose after the catch. (Ball Position needs ball tracking.)
records.measurable_signal: [DRAFT — PROXY | NEW dedicated checkpoint] Immediately after the snap, secure the ball with two hands against the chest BEFORE beginning the fake/rollout — throwing hand back half, off-hand front, elbows close to protect the ball. This is the snap→fake control checkpoint (does the QB establish secure two-hand control before any movement). POSE PROXY = hands-together/height/elbow-tuck; Ball Position needs BALL TRACKING. FORMATION-INDEPENDENT.

records.name: QB - Bootleg - Path / Landmark
records.ideal_execution_standard: Follow the designed rollout path at proper width and depth — ~5-7 yards from the original line of scrimmage (or per system) — maintaining proper spacing and route timing.
records.fault_trigger: Drifting too deep, flattening the rollout, or wrong width/path — collapsing lanes and timing. (Absolute depth needs a scale reference.)
records.measurable_signal: [DRAFT — partly RECOMMENDATION] Follow the rollout path at proper width + depth — ~5-7 yds from the original LOS (or per system), maintaining spacing + route timing. Path DIRECTION/shape measurable; depth ~5-7 yds is a recommendation (relative/needs scale). Needs motion pipeline. FORMATION-INDEPENDENT.

records.name: QB - Bootleg - Play Fake
records.ideal_execution_standard: Execute a convincing run fake — match the timing, body posture, and ball presentation of the called run, selling with shoulders, eyes, hips, and lower body before transitioning into the rollout.
records.fault_trigger: Weak/unconvincing fake — body doesn't sell the run, or poor ball presentation. (Ball-presentation part needs ball tracking; eyes gaze-deferred.)
records.measurable_signal: [DRAFT — PARTIAL] Convincing run fake — match timing, body posture, ball presentation of the called run; sell with shoulders, eyes, hips, lower body before the rollout. FORMATION WORDING: Gun = shotgun fake; Pistol = downhill fake. BODY sell (shoulders/hips/posture) = measurable; BALL presentation = needs BALL TRACKING; eyes/gaze = deferred. Partial. FORMATION-INDEPENDENT.

records.name: QB - Bootleg - Shoulder Alignment

records.fault_trigger: Bobbled/insecure snap, unlevel shoulders, or slow transition to two-hand carriage. (Finger/ball detail needs hand model / ball tracking.)
records.measurable_signal: [DRAFT — folded-in note] Snap received cleanly, fingers naturally spread for a consistent target, elbows relaxed, shoulders level, hips square, transitioning immediately to two-hand carriage before movement. FORMATION WORDING: Under Center = bottom hand receives / guide hand secures top; Gun/Pistol = both hands presented in front of torso, eyes track the ball in (pistol prepares for downhill). Snap detail also folded into Stance. Timing/posture measurable; finger + ball detail needs hand model / ball tracking. FORMATION-INDEPENDENT.

records.ideal_execution_standard: Maintain secure two-hand football control throughout the longer drop — the football remains protected until entering the throwing motion. Both hands stay securely on the ball throughout the drop. Arms and hands stay relaxed but controlled — not stiff, not so loose that the ball drifts and body position goes with it. Hands do not cross the body’s midline.
records.fault_trigger: Ball drops off the chest or elbows flare during the longer drop. (Ball Position needs ball tracking.) Dropping to one hand on the ball. Arms stiff, or flailing/crossing the body’s midline, forcing the torso to overwork and sapping rotational energy. Ball drifting off a consistent carriage position.
records.measurable_signal: [DRAFT — PROXY] Secure two-hand football control throughout the longer drop — ball protected until the throwing motion. POSE PROXY = hands-together/height/elbow-tuck; Ball Position needs BALL TRACKING. Partial.
records.coaching_cue: Two hands on it — relaxed, not loose.

records.name: QB - Pistol - 5 Step - Base Width
records.ideal_execution_standard: Establish a stable throwing base at the completion of the drop — feet positioned for immediate release.
records.fault_trigger: Base too narrow/wide at the top of the drop.
records.measurable_signal: [DRAFT] Stable throwing base at the completion of the drop — feet positioned for immediate release. Base width measurable relative to shoulders. Size-independent. Needs motion pipeline.

records.name: QB - Pistol - 5 Step - Drop Depth
records.ideal_execution_standard: Maintain proper pistol depth relationship from the center while reaching the required passing depth — creating space without drifting excessively deep.
records.fault_trigger: Drifts excessively deep or wrong depth relationship. (Absolute depth needs a scale reference.)
records.measurable_signal: [DRAFT — partly RECOMMENDATION] Maintain proper pistol depth relationship from center while reaching the required passing depth — create space without drifting excessively deep. Relative depth measurable; absolute needs a scale. Needs motion pipeline.

records.name: QB - Pistol - 5 Step - Drop Rhythm
records.ideal_execution_standard: Maintain consistent tempo throughout all five steps — smooth and connected to the throwing motion.
records.fault_trigger: Rushed, paused, or disconnected tempo through the steps.
records.measurable_signal: [DRAFT] Consistent tempo through all five steps — smooth + connected to the throwing motion. Tempo/rhythm measurable. Needs motion pipeline.

records.name: QB - Pistol - 5 Step - First Step
records.ideal_execution_standard: Execute a strong first step that initiates depth while maintaining balance and throwing posture.
records.fault_trigger: Weak or off-balance first step that fails to create depth.
records.measurable_signal: [DRAFT] Strong first step initiating depth while maintaining balance + throwing posture. First-step drive measurable. Needs motion pipeline.

records.name: QB - Pistol - 5 Step - Foot Placement
records.ideal_execution_standard: Feet glide low to the ground throughout the drop — cleats cutting grass, staying in contact so a balanced throwing base is available immediately. The two designed crossover steps are FOOT crossing past foot while the knees stay on a linear path; the knees do not cross over one another as in a karaoke drill. Base stays wide enough to hold balance and weight stays centred, not forward on the front foot.
records.fault_trigger: Bouncing, high-stepping, or riding up on the toes instead of gliding. Knees crossing (karaoke-style) rather than the feet gliding past. Base narrowing so the body leans and loses balance. Weight shifting forward onto the front foot, preventing a clean load. Toes pointing backward or knees swinging wide off the linear path. Crossing at a speed that costs control. Unnecessary foot movement.
records.measurable_signal: [DRAFT] Feet glide low to the ground — low vertical oscillation of the ankles/hips, ground contact maintained. The TWO designed crossovers are foot crossing past foot; knee separation must be maintained (knees not crossing, karaoke-style). Base width held, weight not forward on the front foot. Glide/bounce, knee separation, base width and crossover detection all measurable. Needs motion pipeline.
records.coaching_cue: Cut grass with your cleats — feet glide, knees don't cross.

records.name: QB - Pistol - 5 Step - Head / Eyes
records.ideal_execution_standard: Maintain disciplined downfield vision throughout the drop while processing coverage and defensive movement. Head stays stable and level over the spine throughout the drop — no bouncing, dipping, or rocking of the upper body, which costs spatial awareness and balance.
records.fault_trigger: Head drops/bobs or eyes come down during the drop. (Gaze/reads not pose-measurable — deferred.) Head bouncing, dipping, or rocking through the drop; upper body unstable, degrading spatial awareness and balance.
records.measurable_signal: [DRAFT — PARTIAL] Disciplined downfield vision throughout the drop while processing coverage + defensive movement. Head orientation measurable; gaze/reads deferred. Partial.

records.name: QB - Pistol - 5 Step - Hip Alignment
records.ideal_execution_standard: Hips remain underneath the torso and prepared to transfer power efficiently into the throw. Hips stay loose and mobile through the crossover so weight can transfer cleanly into the throw.
records.fault_trigger: Hips drift from under the torso or misalign for power transfer. Back hip locked or tight through the crossover, preventing clean weight transfer.
records.measurable_signal: [DRAFT] Hips under the torso + prepared to transfer power efficiently into the throw. Hip-line + position measurable. Needs motion pipeline.

records.name: QB - Pistol - 5 Step - Plant Position
records.ideal_execution_standard: Reach the top of the drop with correct plant foot location and balanced posture to transition into the throw.
records.fault_trigger: No clean plant — feet drift or unbalanced at the top.
records.measurable_signal: [DRAFT] Reach the top of the drop with correct plant foot location + balanced posture to transition into the throw. Plant-foot detection + timing measurable. Needs motion pipeline.

records.name: QB - Pistol - 5 Step - Shoulder Alignment
records.ideal_execution_standard: Shoulders remain level and controlled throughout the drop while preparing to rotate into the throw. Shoulders stay level and controlled through the drop. The front shoulder neither collapses nor over-rotates — either turns the hips prematurely and blinds vision to one side.
records.fault_trigger: Shoulders open early or tilt during the drop. Shoulders opening to the field too early, letting defenders read the throw instantly. Front shoulder collapsing or over-rotating, turning the hips early and cutting off vision to one side.
records.measurable_signal: [DRAFT] Shoulders level + controlled throughout the drop while preparing to rotate into the throw. Shoulder-line angle measurable. Needs motion pipeline.

records.name: QB - Pistol - 5 Step - Stance Transition
records.ideal_execution_standard: Transition smoothly from the pistol stance into the five-step drop — securing the snap, maintaining athletic posture, and creating depth without unnecessary movement.
records.fault_trigger: Unnecessary movement or lost posture transitioning into the drop.
records.measurable_signal: [DRAFT] Transition smoothly from pistol stance into the five-step drop — secure the snap, maintain athletic posture, create depth without unnecessary movement. Transition timing + posture measurable. Needs motion pipeline.

records.name: QB - Pistol - 5 Step - Step Length
records.ideal_execution_standard: Maintain consistent stride length throughout the five-step progression while preserving balance and throwing readiness. Stride length stays consistent and matched to the route’s timing — neither over-long nor choppy.
records.fault_trigger: Inconsistent or overstriding through the progression. Steps too long or too choppy, so the rhythm of the drop no longer matches the pass route.
records.measurable_signal: [DRAFT] Consistent stride length throughout the five-step progression while preserving balance + throwing readiness. Stride length measurable. Needs motion pipeline.

records.name: QB - Pistol - 5 Step - Step Sequence
records.ideal_execution_standard: Complete the five-step progression with consistent rhythm, spacing, and body control — maintaining timing with deeper route concepts. The drop contains TWO crossover steps, building depth before finishing on a balanced plant.
records.fault_trigger: Wrong step count or inconsistent rhythm/spacing. Fewer or more than two crossovers, or crossovers on the wrong steps. Steps too long or too choppy so the rhythm no longer matches the route.
records.measurable_signal: [DRAFT] Complete the five-step progression with consistent rhythm, spacing, body control — maintain timing with deeper route concepts. Contains TWO crossovers. Step count, crossover count + position, and rhythm all measurable. Needs motion pipeline.
records.coaching_cue: Cut grass with your cleats — stay low, don't bounce.

records.name: QB - Pistol - 5 Step - Throwing Platform
records.ideal_execution_standard: Finish with a complete throwing platform — balanced feet, loaded hips, aligned shoulders, proper weight transfer, and immediate throwing capability. Weight transfers off the back foot into the throw, generating ground force rather than leaving the throw to the arm.
records.fault_trigger: Finishes off-balance or not throwing-ready at the top of the drop. Weight stuck on the back foot at release, so the throw lacks ground force and becomes all arm.
records.measurable_signal: [DRAFT] Finish with a complete throwing platform — balanced feet, loaded hips, aligned shoulders, proper weight transfer, immediate throwing capability. Measurable from pose. Needs motion pipeline.

records.name: QB - Pistol - Hand Off - Ball Carriage
records.ideal_execution_standard: Secure the football with two hands — throwing hand controls the back half, off-hand secures the front — ball tight to the chest/torso until the exchange phase.
records.fault_trigger: Ball loose/low or away from the torso approaching the exchange. (Ball position needs ball tracking.)
records.measurable_signal: [DRAFT — PROXY] Secure the ball with two hands — throwing hand back half, off-hand front half — tight to the chest/torso until the exchange phase. POSE PROXY = hands-together/height/elbow-tuck; ball position needs BALL TRACKING. FORMATION-INDEPENDENT.

records.name: QB - Pistol - Hand Off - Ball Placement
records.ideal_execution_standard: Place the football into the pocket created by the RB's arms and body — correct height, angle, and firmness, with nose/tip placement matching the running back's carry technique.
records.fault_trigger: Poor placement — wrong height/angle/firmness or misaligned with the RB's pocket. (Fully needs ball tracking + the RB — not measurable solo.)
records.measurable_signal: [DRAFT — FULLY DEFERRED, BALL + RB] Place the ball into the pocket created by the RB's arms/body — correct height, angle, firmness, nose/tip matching the RB's carry technique; stays aligned/secure until the RB completes possession. PURELY ball + the RB's arms — the MOST ball/2-person-dependent measurement in the QB catalogue. NOT measurable solo. Needs BALL TRACKING + RB. FORMATION-INDEPENDENT.

records.name: QB - Pistol - Hand Off - Ball Security
records.ideal_execution_standard: Maintain two-hand control until the RB has secured possession — do not pull away early or expose the football during the exchange.
records.fault_trigger: Pulls away early, releases to one hand, or exposes the ball before the RB secures it. (Ball position + possession need ball tracking + the RB.)
records.measurable_signal: [DRAFT — PROXY] Two-hand control until the RB clearly secures possession — don't pull away early or expose the ball during the exchange. POSE PROXY = hands-together/high; FULL confirmation needs BALL TRACKING + the RB. Partial. FORMATION-INDEPENDENT.

records.name: QB - Pistol - Hand Off - Depth Control
records.ideal_execution_standard: From the pistol alignment (closer to the line, roughly 3 yards, upright to survey the defense), maintain the correct depth relationship so the exchange with the deeper-aligned tailback keeps its timing, spacing, and blocking angles.
records.fault_trigger: Wrong pistol depth relationship, breaking timing/spacing/blocking angles. (~3 yards is a recommendation, not a calibrated threshold; absolute depth needs a scale reference.)
records.measurable_signal: [DRAFT — RECOMMENDATION/relative | PISTOL] Pistol ~3 yds, upright — maintain the depth relationship so the deeper-aligned tailback's exchange keeps timing/spacing/blocking angles. Relative depth measurable; absolute needs a scale (~3 yds is a recommendation, not a threshold).

records.name: QB - Pistol - Hand Off - Exchange Timing
records.ideal_execution_standard: Execute the QB's own footwork and hands into the mesh with smooth, unhurried timing and rhythm — no hesitation or rushing on the way to and through the exchange, matching the designed track and tempo. (What the camera can judge is the QB's own step timing and rhythm into the mesh; the two-player synchronisation with the running back needs the RB in frame.)
records.fault_trigger: Hesitation, rushing, or a broken rhythm in the QB's own steps and hands into the mesh. (Whether the exchange itself is synchronised with the running back needs the RB in frame; not judged from a solo clip.)
records.measurable_signal: [DRAFT — PARTIAL (retiered from No)] The QB's own step timing + rhythm into the mesh — smooth, unhurried, matching the designed track/tempo. Measurable from pose (the QB's own body); the two-player synchronisation with the RB needs the RB in frame (deferred).

records.name: QB - Pistol - Hand Off - Eyes / Head Position
records.ideal_execution_standard: Maintain appropriate eye discipline based on the run concept — eyes support deception without interfering with the exchange mechanics.
records.fault_trigger: Eyes tip the play or disrupt the exchange. (Eye gaze/discipline not pose-measurable — deferred.)
records.measurable_signal: [DRAFT — PARTIAL] Appropriate eye discipline for the run concept — eyes support deception without interfering with the exchange / tipping the play. Head ORIENTATION measurable; actual EYE gaze/discipline = deferred (not pose-measurable). Partial. FORMATION-INDEPENDENT.

records.name: QB - Pistol - Hand Off - Finish Mechanics
records.ideal_execution_standard: Complete the exchange with proper follow-through — maintain balance and continue the designed carry-out, fake, boot, or protection responsibility.
records.fault_trigger: Stops/stands up or loses balance instead of continuing the designed carry-out action. (Exchange-completion part needs the RB.)
records.measurable_signal: [DRAFT — PARTIAL] Complete the exchange with proper follow-through — maintain balance and continue the designed carry-out, fake, boot, or protection action. The CONTINUATION action (QB's own body + balance) = measurable from pose (and reuses Bootleg/Play-Action rows). The exchange completion itself needs the RB. Partial. FORMATION-INDEPENDENT.

records.name: QB - Pistol - Hand Off - Footwork
records.ideal_execution_standard: Use a tight two-step footwork pattern (for example opening at roughly 45° into the A-gap) to clear entirely off the center-to-tailback straight line, aligning the toes parallel to the running back's incoming track — controlled, downhill-connected steps with proper spacing, timing and balance.
records.fault_trigger: Failing to clear the center-to-tailback line, a loose or wide pattern instead of the tight two-step, or toes not aligned to the back's track. (The 45° / A-gap opening is illustrative of clearing the midline, not a fixed threshold; the aiming point depends on the run concept, which is not captured — reported, not judged.)
records.measurable_signal: [DRAFT — NEEDS MOTION | PISTOL] Tight two-step pattern (e.g. ~45° into the A-gap, illustrative not a threshold) to clear the center-to-tailback line; toes parallel to the RB's track; controlled downhill steps. Step/open-angle + track measurable; aiming point (run concept) deferred — report, don't judge.

records.name: QB - Pistol - Hand Off - Hip Alignment
records.ideal_execution_standard: Keep hips aligned with the exchange path, square and underneath the body to support balance — avoid early opening that exposes the football.
records.fault_trigger: Hips open early or drift off the exchange path, exposing the ball / hurting balance.
records.measurable_signal: [DRAFT] Hips aligned with the exchange path, kept square + underneath the body to support balance/efficient movement; avoid early opening that exposes the ball. Hip-line + position measurable from pose. FORMATION-INDEPENDENT.

records.name: QB - Pistol - Hand Off - Mesh Point
records.ideal_execution_standard: From the pistol, reach a downhill mesh on a balanced base with the ball seated near the back hip/belly and soft, pressure-ready hands, letting the deeper-aligned tailback press straight through the mesh point. (Camera judges the QB's downhill track, base, and ball position relative to his body; the exchange itself needs the RB.)
records.fault_trigger: Losing the downhill track or the balanced base, or the ball not seated for the deeper tailback's straight path through the mesh. (The running back securing the exchange needs the RB and ball tracking; not judged from a solo clip.)
records.measurable_signal: [DRAFT — PARTIAL (retiered from No) | PISTOL] Downhill mesh, balanced base, ball seated near the back hip/belly with soft pressure-ready hands for the deeper tailback's straight path. PROXY (solo) = downhill track, base, ball-vs-body position; the exchange needs the RB + ball tracking.

records.name: QB - Pistol - Hand Off - Shoulder Alignment
records.ideal_execution_standard: Position shoulders to support the exchange while maintaining body control and allowing the RB a clear running path — avoid early/unnecessary rotation.
records.fault_trigger: Early/over-rotation of the shoulders, exposing the ball or disrupting placement.
records.measurable_signal: [DRAFT] Shoulders positioned to support the exchange + give the RB a clear running path; controlled, avoiding early/unnecessary rotation that exposes the ball or disrupts placement. Shoulder-line angle + rotation-timing measurable from pose. FORMATION-INDEPENDENT.

records.name: QB - Pistol - Hand Off - Snap Timing / Reception
records.ideal_execution_standard: Receive the pistol snap — aligned closer to the line (roughly 3 yards) in an upright posture to survey the defense, catching the ball cleanly and preparing for the downhill mesh — with proper timing and rhythm, body balanced and prepared to execute the exchange.
records.fault_trigger: Mistimed or bobbled catch, or an unbalanced entry that isn't ready for the downhill mesh. (Hand/ball detail needs the hand model / ball tracking; ~3 yards is a recommendation, not a threshold.)
records.measurable_signal: [DRAFT — PARTIAL | PISTOL] ~3 yds, upright to survey; clean catch preparing for the downhill mesh; timing/rhythm, balanced into the exchange. Timing/balance/posture measurable; hand/ball detail needs the hand model / ball tracking.

records.name: QB - Pistol - Stance - Base Width
records.ideal_execution_standard: Feet establish an athletic base supporting downhill movement immediately following snap reception.
records.fault_trigger: Base too narrow/wide for balanced downhill movement.
records.measurable_signal: [DRAFT] Athletic base supporting downhill movement immediately following snap reception. Base width measurable relative to shoulders. Size-independent.

records.name: QB - Pistol - Stance - Depth from Center
records.ideal_execution_standard: Align at the prescribed depth behind the center to ensure the football enters the optimal receiving window and preserves offensive timing.
records.fault_trigger: Too shallow/deep behind center, hurting the window or timing. (Absolute depth needs a scale reference.)
records.measurable_signal: [DRAFT — RECOMMENDATION/relative] PISTOL depth: align at the prescribed depth behind center so the ball enters the optimal receiving window + preserves offensive timing. Pistol depth is SHORTER than shotgun (~3-3.5 yds vs ~5). Relative depth/alignment measurable; absolute needs a scale reference. Partial.

records.name: QB - Pistol - Stance - Foot Alignment
records.ideal_execution_standard: Feet maintain proper stagger, toe angle, and alignment for balanced snap reception and efficient first movement.
records.fault_trigger: Wrong stagger/toe angle — unstable reception or inefficient first movement.
records.measurable_signal: [DRAFT] Proper stagger, toe angle, alignment — balanced snap reception + efficient first movement. Foot stagger/angle measurable. Size-independent.

records.name: QB - Pistol - Stance - Hand Position (Receiving Window)
records.ideal_execution_standard: Hands positioned comfortably in front of the torso at the anticipated snap location — fingers naturally spread and relaxed with elbows slightly flexed, creating a consistent receiving window that cushions the football into secure two-hand possession.
records.fault_trigger: Hands off the window, stiff, or poor finger spread. (Finger detail needs the hand model.)
records.measurable_signal: [DRAFT — NEEDS HAND MODEL] PISTOL receiving window: hands comfortably in front of the torso at the anticipated snap location; fingers naturally spread + relaxed, elbows slightly flexed, a consistent window cushioning the ball into secure two-hand possession. Hand POSITION = pose-measurable; FINGER detail = needs the Hand landmarker. Partial.

records.name: QB - Pistol - Stance - Head / Eyes
records.ideal_execution_standard: Head remains neutral while eyes focus on the expected snap location and maintain awareness of defensive alignment.
records.fault_trigger: Head not neutral/level. (Actual eye focus not pose-measurable — deferred.)
records.measurable_signal: [DRAFT — PARTIAL] Head neutral while eyes focus on the expected snap location + defensive alignment. Head ORIENTATION measurable; actual EYE focus = deferred. Partial.

records.name: QB - Pistol - Stance - Hip Alignment
records.ideal_execution_standard: Hips remain square underneath the torso, allowing immediate power generation after the catch.
records.fault_trigger: Hips off-square or not underneath the torso.
records.measurable_signal: [DRAFT] Hips square underneath the torso — immediate power generation after the catch. Hip-line + position measurable. Size-independent.

records.name: QB - Pistol - Stance - Knee Flexion
records.ideal_execution_standard: Knees remain slightly flexed to maintain an explosive athletic posture while preparing for the snap.
records.fault_trigger: Knees locked or over-bent — loses explosive readiness.
records.measurable_signal: [DRAFT] Knees slightly flexed — explosive athletic posture while preparing for the snap. Knee angle measurable. Size-independent.

records.name: QB - Pistol - Stance - Pad Level
records.ideal_execution_standard: Maintain loaded hips, controlled chest, and neutral spine to support both downhill run action and passing mechanics.
records.fault_trigger: Hips unloaded/too high or spine rounded — poor support for run/pass.
records.measurable_signal: [DRAFT] Loaded hips, controlled chest, neutral spine — supports both downhill run action + passing mechanics. Pad level + posture measurable. Size-independent.

records.name: QB - Pistol - Stance - Shoulder Alignment
records.ideal_execution_standard: Shoulders remain square to the line of scrimmage while supporting efficient transition into the offensive concept.
records.fault_trigger: Shoulders not square to the LOS.
records.measurable_signal: [DRAFT] Shoulders square to the LOS — efficient transition into the offensive concept. Shoulder-line angle measurable. Size-independent.

records.name: QB - Pistol - Stance - Weight Distribution
records.ideal_execution_standard: Weight remains balanced through the mid-foot and balls of the feet, supporting efficient reception and downhill movement.
records.fault_trigger: Weight on the heels — delays downhill movement. (Force is a proxy via ankle/COM position.)
records.measurable_signal: [DRAFT — partial force proxy] Weight balanced through mid-foot + balls of the feet for efficient reception + downhill movement. Weight = proxy (ankle-over-mid-foot is the signal). Partial.

records.name: QB - Play Action - Ball Carriage
records.ideal_execution_standard: Secure the football with two hands at chest level — throwing hand controls the back half, off-hand protects the front — ball tight to the body frame with elbows close until the mesh action begins.
records.fault_trigger: Ball loose/low, elbows flared, or away from the body before the mesh. (Ball Position needs ball tracking.)
records.measurable_signal: [DRAFT — PROXY] Two hands at chest level — throwing hand back half, off-hand front — ball tight to the body frame, elbows close, until the mesh begins. POSE PROXY = hands-together/height/elbow-tuck; Ball Position needs BALL TRACKING. FORMATION-INDEPENDENT.

records.name: QB - Play Action - Ball Security
records.ideal_execution_standard: Maintain two-hand security during the fake and transition — the ball remains protected against the body until the QB commits to the throw.
records.fault_trigger: Ball exposed or dropped to one hand during the fake/transition. (Ball Position needs ball tracking.)
records.measurable_signal: [DRAFT — PROXY] Two-hand security through the fake and transition; ball protected against the body until committing to the throw (cross-cutting Ball Security). POSE PROXY = hands-together/high; FULL confirmation needs BALL TRACKING. Partial. FORMATION-INDEPENDENT.

records.name: QB - Play Action - Depth Control
records.ideal_execution_standard: Maintain proper depth from the line of scrimmage after the snap and fake — depth creates throwing lanes while preserving route timing.
records.fault_trigger: Too shallow (no lane) or too deep/drifting after the fake, breaking timing. (Absolute depth needs a scale reference.)
records.measurable_signal: [DRAFT — RECOMMENDATION/relative] Maintain proper depth from the LOS after snap + fake (pistol: relationship from center + backfield action) — depth creates throwing lanes while preserving route timing. Relative depth/position measurable; absolute needs a scale. Partial. FORMATION-INDEPENDENT.

records.name: QB - Play Action - Fake Mechanics
records.ideal_execution_standard: Sell the run by committing the entire body — eyes, shoulders, hips, and ball presentation replicate the intended run concept; avoid pulling the ball early, creating a believable run picture before transitioning to throw.
records.fault_trigger: Half-hearted body commitment or pulling the ball early — no believable run picture. (Ball-presentation + eye parts need ball tracking / are gaze-deferred.)
records.measurable_signal: [DRAFT — PARTIAL] Sell the run with full-body commitment — eyes, shoulders, hips, ball presentation replicate the run concept; don't pull the ball early; create a believable run picture. Pistol = downhill full-body sell. BODY sell (shoulder/hip/posture + not-pulling-early timing) = measurable; BALL presentation = needs BALL TRACKING; eyes/gaze = deferred. Partial. FORMATION-INDEPENDENT.
records.pose_landmarks_note: (Ball Position needs ball tracking; eyes = gaze deferred.)

records.name: QB - Play Action - Footwork Transition
records.ideal_execution_standard: Transition from the fake into the designed pass footwork with efficient steps — feet under the body, maintaining balance, rhythm, and timing.
records.fault_trigger: Wasted/choppy steps or feet out from under the body transitioning into the pass phase.
records.measurable_signal: [DRAFT] Transition from the fake into the pass footwork with efficient steps — feet under the body, throwing rhythm/balance/timing maintained. Footwork efficiency + step detection measurable from pose. FORMATION-INDEPENDENT.

records.name: QB - Play Action - Head / Eyes
records.ideal_execution_standard: Use the eyes to influence defenders during the fake, then quickly transition vision to the defensive read and receiver progression while maintaining body control.
records.fault_trigger: Eyes give away the fake or fail to transition to the read. (Eye gaze/reads not pose-measurable — deferred.)
records.measurable_signal: [DRAFT — PARTIAL] Use eyes to influence defenders during the fake, then transition vision to the read/receiver progression while keeping body control. Head ORIENTATION measurable; actual EYE gaze/reads = deferred (not pose-measurable). Partial. FORMATION-INDEPENDENT.

records.name: QB - Play Action - Hip Alignment
records.ideal_execution_standard: Keep hips controlled during the fake, then rotate efficiently through the throw to generate power and maintain accuracy.
records.fault_trigger: Hips over-open early or fail to rotate through the throw, losing power/accuracy.
records.measurable_signal: [DRAFT] Hips controlled during the fake, then rotate efficiently through the throw for power + accuracy (pistol: keep hips underneath the body). Hip-line + rotation timing measurable from pose. FORMATION-INDEPENDENT.

records.name: QB - Play Action - Mesh Point
records.ideal_execution_standard: Execute the fake at correct depth, timing, and spacing with the RB — present the ball into the exchange window with both hands, extend to sell the run, hold the mesh long enough to influence defenders, then retract smoothly into a secure throwing position.
records.fault_trigger: Wrong mesh depth/timing/spacing, weak extension, or rushed retraction. (Mesh quality needs the RB + ball — not measurable solo.)
records.measurable_signal: [DRAFT — mostly DEFERRED, 2-PERSON + BALL] Fake at correct depth/timing/spacing with the RB: present the ball into the exchange window with both hands, extend to sell the run, hold the mesh to influence defenders, then retract smoothly into a secure throwing position. Pistol = downhill exchange point. Mirrors Hand Off Mesh Point (difference: here the QB PULLS + throws). HEAVILY 2-person + ball. PROXY (solo) = QB's extend-retract arm motion + footwork/position. FORMATION-INDEPENDENT.
records.pose_landmarks_note: (Mesh quality needs the RB + Ball Position.)

records.name: QB - Play Action - Post-Fake Reset
records.ideal_execution_standard: Regain a balanced throwing posture with feet underneath the body, hips loaded, knees slightly bent, and shoulders ready to align toward the target.
records.fault_trigger: Fails to reset into a loaded, aligned, throwing-ready posture after the fake.
records.measurable_signal: [DRAFT] Regain a throwing-ready posture — knees slightly bent, hips loaded, feet under the body, shoulders ready to align to the target. The reset-to-throw state (base + load + alignment) measurable from pose. FORMATION-INDEPENDENT.

records.name: QB - Play Action - Shoulder Alignment
records.ideal_execution_standard: Maintain controlled shoulders through the fake, then rotate efficiently toward the target without opening early.
records.fault_trigger: Shoulders open early or over-rotate through the fake, hurting accuracy.
records.measurable_signal: [DRAFT] Controlled shoulders through the fake, then rotate efficiently toward the target without opening early (which hurts accuracy). Shoulder-line angle + open-timing measurable from pose. FORMATION-INDEPENDENT.

records.name: QB - Play Action - Snap Timing / Reception
records.ideal_execution_standard: Receive the snap with proper timing and rhythm from cadence — body balanced — and transition smoothly into the designed play-action footwork.
records.fault_trigger: Mistimed/bobbled snap or unbalanced/slow transition into the play-action footwork. (Finger/ball detail needs hand model / ball tracking.)
records.measurable_signal: [DRAFT — folded-in note] Snap received with proper timing/rhythm from cadence, body balanced, transitions smoothly into play-action footwork. Under center = hands under center; gun/pistol = clean catch (pistol prepares for downhill). Snap detail also folded into Stance. Timing/balance/transition measurable; finger + ball detail needs hand model / ball tracking. FORMATION-INDEPENDENT.

records.name: QB - Play Action - Throw Timing
records.ideal_execution_standard: Deliver the football on schedule based on the route concept and defensive reaction while maintaining rhythm from fake to throw.
records.fault_trigger: Late/early or arrhythmic delivery from fake to throw. (On-schedule-for-route/defense judgment needs the route + defense; ball flight needs ball tracking — deferred.)
records.measurable_signal: [DRAFT — PARTIAL] Deliver on schedule per the route concept + defensive reaction, keeping rhythm from fake to throw. The QB's release TIMING/rhythm (fake→throw) is measurable from body motion; but 'on schedule for the route/defense' depends on the ROUTE + DEFENSE not in a solo clip — that judgment is deferred. Ball flight needs ball tracking. Partial. FORMATION-INDEPENDENT.

records.name: QB - Play Action - Throwing Platform

records.fault_trigger: Shoulders rotate off the target during the jump — accuracy suffers.
records.measurable_signal: [DRAFT] Shoulders stay directed toward the target through the jump and release. Landmarks: lead shoulder, throwing shoulder. Shoulder-line angle through the airborne phase measurable. Needs motion pipeline.

records.name: QB - Throwing - Jump Pass - Takeoff Mechanics
records.ideal_execution_standard: Initiate controlled upward movement without disrupting throwing posture — the jump creates separation while maintaining directional control.
records.fault_trigger: Jump disrupts throwing posture or drifts off-line — lost control and accuracy.
records.measurable_signal: [DRAFT] Controlled upward movement WITHOUT disrupting throwing posture; jump creates separation while keeping directional control. Landmarks: feet, knees, hips, center of mass. Takeoff timing + vertical/directional control measurable. Needs motion pipeline.

records.name: QB - Throwing - Overhand - Arm Path
records.ideal_execution_standard: Throwing arm follows an efficient overhand path — elbow connected to shoulder position, hand traveling behind and through the football.
records.fault_trigger: Elbow drops/disconnects or the arm loops — inefficient, inconsistent path. (Ball position itself needs ball tracking.)
records.measurable_signal: [DRAFT] Efficient overhand arm path; elbow stays connected to shoulder position; hand travels behind and through the ball. Landmarks: shoulder, elbow, wrist, hand (ball needs tracking). Arm-path geometry measurable; the BALL point needs ball tracking. Needs motion pipeline.

records.name: QB - Throwing - Overhand - Ball Placement
records.ideal_execution_standard: Deliver the football with appropriate velocity, trajectory, and location based on the route and defensive situation.
records.fault_trigger: Wrong velocity/trajectory/location for the route. (Ball outcome + accuracy need ball tracking + a target — not measurable solo.)
records.measurable_signal: [DRAFT — DEFERRED, BALL] Deliver with appropriate velocity, trajectory, location for the route/defense. Landmarks: release location, hand position, shoulder alignment, ball path. The BALL outcome (velocity/trajectory/location/accuracy) needs BALL TRACKING (+ target for accuracy). The body mechanics producing it are measurable via the other rows. Deferred.
records.pose_landmarks_note: (Not pose-measurable — ball velocity, trajectory, and location need ball tracking plus the receiver/defender context.)

records.name: QB - Throwing - Overhand - Follow Through
records.ideal_execution_standard: Throwing hand finishes toward the target; body decelerates naturally while maintaining balance and a recovery position.
records.fault_trigger: Hand cuts off early/across the body, or QB loses balance on the finish.
records.measurable_signal: [DRAFT] Throwing hand finishes toward the target; body decelerates naturally, maintaining balance + recovery. Landmarks: throwing hand, elbow, shoulders, hips, feet. Finish direction + deceleration + balance all measurable. Needs motion pipeline.

records.name: QB - Throwing - Overhand - Head / Eyes
records.ideal_execution_standard: Head remains stable over the spine; eyes stay focused on the target throughout the throwing sequence.
records.fault_trigger: Head drifts off the spine or destabilizes through the throw. (Actual eye gaze not pose-measurable — deferred.)
records.measurable_signal: [DRAFT — PARTIAL] Head stable over the spine; eyes on target throughout. Landmarks: head, neck, eye direction. Head STABILITY/orientation = measurable (head over spine); actual EYE gaze = deferred (not pose-measurable). Partial. Needs motion pipeline.

records.name: QB - Throwing - Overhand - Hip Rotation
records.ideal_execution_standard: Hips initiate the throwing sequence before the shoulders — pelvis rotates toward the target while maintaining balance and preventing lateral slide.
records.fault_trigger: Shoulders open before hips (out of sequence) or hips slide laterally — lost power and accuracy.
records.measurable_signal: [DRAFT] Hips INITIATE the sequence BEFORE shoulder rotation — pelvis rotates toward target, balanced, no lateral slide. Landmarks: left hip, right hip, pelvis angle, shoulders, spine. The hip-before-shoulder TIMING is a signature measurable signal. Size-independent. Needs motion pipeline.

records.name: QB - Throwing - Overhand - Lower Body Position
records.ideal_execution_standard: Stable throwing base with feet ~shoulder-width apart, knees flexed, hips lowered, athletic torso, weight centered to allow efficient force transfer.
records.fault_trigger: Base too narrow/wide, stiff knees, or off-center weight — poor force transfer.
records.measurable_signal: [DRAFT] Stable base ~shoulder-width feet, knees flexed, hips lowered, athletic torso, weight centered for force transfer. Landmarks: feet, knees, hips, spine, shoulders. Size-independent (relative to shoulders). Needs motion pipeline.

records.name: QB - Throwing - Overhand - Release Point
records.ideal_execution_standard: Ball releases at the optimal point above and slightly forward of the throwing shoulder, with arm extension and body alignment supporting accuracy.
records.fault_trigger: Release too low/late/far forward, or short arm extension — accuracy and velocity drop. (Exact ball-release point needs ball tracking.)
records.measurable_signal: [DRAFT] Release above and slightly forward of the throwing shoulder; arm extension + alignment support accuracy. Landmarks: shoulder, elbow, wrist (ball needs tracking). The ARM-EXTENSION point/geometry is measurable; the exact ball-release instant needs ball tracking. Needs motion pipeline.

records.name: QB - Throwing - Overhand - Shoulder Alignment
records.ideal_execution_standard: Front shoulder stays directed toward the target during loading; shoulders rotate after hip initiation and remain level through release.
records.fault_trigger: Front shoulder opens early or shoulders tilt/dip through release — accuracy and power suffer.
records.measurable_signal: [DRAFT] Front shoulder directed at target during loading; shoulders rotate AFTER hip initiation, stay level through release. Landmarks: lead shoulder, throwing shoulder, chest orientation. Shoulder-line angle + rotation timing. Size-independent. Needs motion pipeline.

records.name: QB - Throwing - Overhand - Weight Transfer
records.ideal_execution_standard: Transfer force from the back leg through the hips into the target direction; the lead leg creates stability, preventing excessive drift or collapse.
records.fault_trigger: Weight drifts or collapses, or force stays on the back leg — power leaks out of the throw.
records.measurable_signal: [DRAFT — partial force proxy] Force transfers back-leg→hips→target; lead leg stabilizes, no excessive drift/collapse. Landmarks: trail foot, lead foot, knees, hips, center of mass. MOTION/direction measurable; actual force is a proxy. Needs motion pipeline.

records.name: QB - Throwing - Overhand - Wrist / Hand Position
records.ideal_execution_standard: Fingers positioned behind the football to create controlled rotation; wrist snaps naturally through release while maintaining ball control.
records.fault_trigger: Fingers off-center or no wrist snap — wobbly, uncontrolled rotation. (Finger detail needs the hand model; rotation needs ball tracking.)
records.measurable_signal: [DRAFT — NEEDS HAND MODEL] Fingers behind the ball for controlled rotation; wrist snaps naturally through release. Landmarks: wrist, hand, fingers, ball. Wrist POSITION = pose now; FINGER placement + wrist snap = needs the Hand landmarker; ball rotation needs ball tracking. Partial.
records.pose_landmarks_note: (Thumb/finger points need the Hand landmarker; Ball Position needs ball tracking.)

records.name: QB - Throwing - Rotation / Torque - Arm Path
records.ideal_execution_standard: Arm accelerates after rotational sequencing begins — elbow stays connected to shoulder movement while the hand travels efficiently through the throw.
records.fault_trigger: Arm fires before rotation (out of sequence) or elbow disconnects — arm-dominant, less velocity.
records.measurable_signal: [DRAFT] Arm accelerates AFTER rotational sequencing begins; elbow stays connected to shoulder movement; hand travels efficiently. Landmarks: shoulder, elbow, wrist, hand. Arm-path geometry + the after-rotation timing measurable. Needs motion pipeline.

records.name: QB - Throwing - Rotation / Torque - Ball Placement
records.ideal_execution_standard: Maintain accuracy while generating increased velocity through rotational force.
records.fault_trigger: Accuracy breaks down as velocity increases. (Velocity/accuracy/trajectory need ball tracking + a target — not measurable solo.)
records.measurable_signal: [DRAFT — DEFERRED, BALL] Maintain accuracy while generating increased velocity through rotational force. Landmarks: release point, hand position, ball trajectory. Velocity/accuracy/trajectory = BALL outcome, needs BALL TRACKING (+ target). Body mechanics producing it are in the other rows. Deferred.
records.pose_landmarks_note: (Not pose-measurable — release point, ball trajectory, and accuracy need ball tracking plus target context.)

records.name: QB - Throwing - Rotation / Torque - Core Rotation
records.ideal_execution_standard: Torso transfers energy from the lower body into the upper body — chest follows hip rotation while maintaining spine alignment.
records.fault_trigger: Torso disconnected from hip rotation or spine collapses — energy leak between lower and upper body.
records.measurable_signal: [DRAFT] Torso transfers energy from lower to upper body — chest follows hip rotation while spine alignment is maintained. Landmarks: spine, chest, shoulders, hips. Chest-follows-hip rotation timing + spine posture measurable. Needs motion pipeline.

records.name: QB - Throwing - Rotation / Torque - Follow Through
records.ideal_execution_standard: Decelerate naturally through the rotation — throwing hand finishes toward the target while maintaining balance.
records.fault_trigger: Abrupt/unbalanced deceleration or hand finishes away from the target.
records.measurable_signal: [DRAFT] Decelerate naturally through rotation; throwing hand finishes toward target, balance maintained. Landmarks: hand, elbow, shoulders, hips. Finish + deceleration + balance measurable. Needs motion pipeline.

records.name: QB - Throwing - Rotation / Torque - Ground Force Production
records.ideal_execution_standard: Generate force through the feet and transfer energy upward through the kinetic chain instead of relying only on the arm.
records.fault_trigger: All-arm throw — no ground-up energy transfer through the chain.
records.measurable_signal: [DRAFT — partial force proxy] Generate force through the feet, transfer energy UP the kinetic chain rather than relying on the arm. Landmarks: feet, ankles, knees, hips, center of mass. The kinetic-chain SEQUENCE/timing (ground→hips) is measurable; actual force is a proxy. Needs motion pipeline.

records.name: QB - Throwing - Rotation / Torque - Hip / Shoulder Separation
records.ideal_execution_standard: Create separation between hips and shoulders during loading — hips begin opening while shoulders remain closed to store rotational energy.
records.fault_trigger: Hips and shoulders open together (no separation) — no stored torque, arm-dominant throw.
records.measurable_signal: [DRAFT] SEPARATION between hips and shoulders during loading — hips begin opening while shoulders stay closed to store rotational energy. Landmarks: hip angle, shoulder angle, torso rotation. This is THE separation signal: the ANGLE between hip-line and shoulder-line — one of the strongest measurable signals in all of throwing. Size-independent. Needs motion pipeline.

records.name: QB - Throwing - Rotation / Torque - Hip Rotation
records.ideal_execution_standard: Pelvis initiates rotation toward the target before the shoulders — hips rotate aggressively while maintaining posture and preventing lateral movement.
records.fault_trigger: Shoulders lead instead of hips, or hips slide laterally — broken sequence, lost torque.
records.measurable_signal: [DRAFT] Pelvis initiates rotation toward target BEFORE shoulders; hips rotate aggressively, posture maintained, no lateral movement. Landmarks: left hip, right hip, pelvis angle. Hip-first timing + rotation measurable. Size-independent. Needs motion pipeline.

records.name: QB - Throwing - Rotation / Torque - Lower Body Position
records.ideal_execution_standard: Strong rotational base — feet connected to the ground, knees loaded, hips athletic, torso stacked over the lower body.
records.fault_trigger: Weak/narrow base or torso not stacked — can't generate or transfer rotational force.
records.measurable_signal: [DRAFT] Strong rotational base, feet connected to the ground, knees loaded, athletic hips, torso stacked over the lower body. Landmarks: feet, knees, hips, spine. Size-independent. Needs motion pipeline.

records.name: QB - Throwing - Rotation / Torque - Release Point
records.ideal_execution_standard: Ball releases after maximum energy transfer from the lower body through the torso; release stays consistent despite increased velocity.
records.fault_trigger: Early release (before full transfer) or release point drifts as velocity rises — inconsistency. (Exact ball point needs ball tracking.)
records.measurable_signal: [DRAFT] Ball releases AFTER maximum energy transfer (lower body→torso); release stays consistent despite increased velocity. Landmarks: shoulder, elbow, wrist (ball needs tracking). Arm-extension/release geometry + timing measurable; exact ball point needs tracking. Needs motion pipeline.

records.name: QB - Throwing - Rotation / Torque - Shoulder Alignment
records.ideal_execution_standard: Front shoulder controls direction while the upper body stays connected to hip rotation; shoulders avoid opening prematurely.
records.fault_trigger: Shoulders open prematurely, spending the stored separation too early.
records.measurable_signal: [DRAFT] Front shoulder controls direction; upper body stays connected to hip rotation; shoulders avoid opening prematurely. Landmarks: lead shoulder, throwing shoulder. Shoulder-line angle + open-timing measurable. Needs motion pipeline.

records.name: QB - Throwing - Sidearm - Arm Path
records.ideal_execution_standard: Arm travels efficiently through a lower horizontal path without excessive side movement or looping.
records.fault_trigger: Excessive side-sweep or looping in the arm path — inefficient, inconsistent sidearm.
records.measurable_signal: [DRAFT] Arm travels efficiently through a lower HORIZONTAL path, no excessive side movement or looping. Landmarks: shoulder, elbow, wrist, hand. Arm-path geometry measurable. Needs motion pipeline.

records.name: QB - Throwing - Sidearm - Arm Slot
records.ideal_execution_standard: Maintain a consistent sidearm angle — elbow position stays connected to shoulder movement and supports the intended throwing lane.
records.fault_trigger: Inconsistent arm slot or elbow disconnected from shoulder — erratic sidearm release.
records.measurable_signal: [DRAFT] Consistent SIDEARM ANGLE; elbow position stays connected to shoulder movement, supporting the intended throwing lane. Landmarks: shoulder, elbow, wrist. THE defining sidearm signal: the arm-slot ANGLE (shoulder-elbow-wrist) — directly measurable, distinguishes sidearm from overhand. Size-independent. Needs motion pipeline.

records.name: QB - Throwing - Sidearm - Ball Placement
records.ideal_execution_standard: Deliver accurate throws through tighter throwing windows while maintaining velocity and control.
records.fault_trigger: Ball misses the tight window or loses velocity. (Accuracy/velocity/window need ball tracking + a target — not measurable solo.)
records.measurable_signal: [DRAFT — DEFERRED, BALL] Deliver accurate throws through tighter windows while keeping velocity/control. Landmarks: release point, ball path. Accuracy/velocity/window = BALL outcome, needs BALL TRACKING (+ target). Body mechanics in the other rows. Deferred.
records.pose_landmarks_note: (Not pose-measurable — release point and ball path need ball tracking plus throwing-window context.)

records.name: QB - Throwing - Sidearm - Hip Rotation
records.ideal_execution_standard: Lower body still initiates force production — hips rotate toward the target while maintaining control.
records.fault_trigger: Arm-dominant throw with hips not initiating, or hips out of control on the lower slot.
records.measurable_signal: [DRAFT] Lower body still initiates force; hips rotate toward the target with control. Landmarks: hips, pelvis angle. Hip rotation + initiation timing measurable. Size-independent. Needs motion pipeline.

records.name: QB - Throwing - Sidearm - Lower Body Position
records.ideal_execution_standard: Athletic throwing base that supports a lower release angle — feet, hips, and shoulders remain connected toward the target.
records.fault_trigger: Base doesn't support the lower slot, or feet/hips/shoulders disconnect from the target line.
records.measurable_signal: [DRAFT] Athletic base supporting a LOWER release angle; feet, hips, shoulders stay connected toward the target. Landmarks: feet, knees, hips, shoulders. Size-independent. Needs motion pipeline.

records.name: QB - Throwing - Sidearm - Release Point
records.ideal_execution_standard: Football releases from a consistent sidearm position with proper timing and trajectory.
records.fault_trigger: Release point varies from throw to throw at the sidearm slot — inconsistency. (Exact ball point needs ball tracking.)
records.measurable_signal: [DRAFT] Ball releases from a CONSISTENT sidearm position with proper timing/trajectory. Landmarks: elbow, wrist (ball needs tracking). Arm-position/release geometry + timing measurable; exact ball point needs tracking. Needs motion pipeline.

records.name: QB - Throwing - Sidearm - Shoulder Alignment
records.ideal_execution_standard: Shoulders remain aligned with the target while supporting the lower arm slot.
records.fault_trigger: Shoulders drift off the target line while dropping to the lower slot.
records.measurable_signal: [DRAFT] Shoulders stay aligned with the target while supporting the lower arm slot. Landmarks: lead shoulder, throwing shoulder. Shoulder-line angle measurable. Needs motion pipeline.

records.name: QB - Throwing - Sidearm - Torso Angle
records.ideal_execution_standard: Adjust body angle to create the sidearm throwing lane while maintaining posture and balance.
records.fault_trigger: Over- or under-adjusting the torso angle, or losing posture/balance creating the lane.
records.measurable_signal: [DRAFT] Adjust BODY ANGLE to create the sidearm throwing lane while keeping posture + balance. Landmarks: spine angle, shoulders, hips. Torso/spine angle is directly measurable — this is the defining sidearm adjustment. Size-independent. Needs motion pipeline.

records.name: QB - Throwing - Sidearm - Weight Transfer
records.ideal_execution_standard: Transfer energy toward the target while avoiding excessive sideways lean or falling away from the throw.
records.fault_trigger: Excessive sideways lean or falling away from the target — lost power and accuracy.
records.measurable_signal: [DRAFT] Transfer energy toward the target WITHOUT excessive sideways lean or falling away. Landmarks: feet, hips, spine. Direction of transfer + lean angle measurable (falling-away is a torso-angle signal). Needs motion pipeline.

records.name: QB - Throwing - Sidearm - Wrist / Hand Position
records.ideal_execution_standard: Fingers control the football's rotation and direction despite the altered arm angle.
records.fault_trigger: Poor finger control at the altered angle — wobble or off-line rotation. (Finger detail needs the hand model; rotation needs ball tracking.)
records.measurable_signal: [DRAFT — NEEDS HAND MODEL] Fingers control ball rotation/direction despite the altered arm angle. Landmarks: wrist, hand, ball. Wrist POSITION = pose; FINGER control = needs the Hand landmarker; ball rotation needs ball tracking. Partial.
records.pose_landmarks_note: (Thumb/finger points need the Hand landmarker; Ball Position needs ball tracking.)

records.name: QB - Under Center - 3 Step - Ball Carriage
records.ideal_execution_standard: Maintain two-hand football security from the snap through the drop — ball near the chest with elbows controlled and ready to transition into the throwing motion. Both hands stay securely on the ball throughout the drop. Arms and hands stay relaxed but controlled — not stiff, not so loose that the ball drifts and body position goes with it. Hands do not cross the body’s midline.
records.fault_trigger: Ball drops off the chest or elbows flare during the drop. (Ball Position needs ball tracking.) Dropping to one hand on the ball. Arms stiff, or flailing/crossing the body’s midline, forcing the torso to overwork and sapping rotational energy. Ball drifting off a consistent carriage position.
records.measurable_signal: [DRAFT — PROXY] Two-hand ball security from snap through the drop — ball near the chest, elbows controlled, ready to transition to the throw. POSE PROXY = hands-together/height/elbow-tuck; Ball Position needs BALL TRACKING. Partial.
records.coaching_cue: Two hands on it — relaxed, not loose.

records.name: QB - Under Center - 3 Step - Base Width
records.ideal_execution_standard: Maintain an athletic throwing base at the completion of the drop — feet positioned to support immediate throwing mechanics.
records.fault_trigger: Base too narrow/wide at the top of the drop for immediate throwing.
records.measurable_signal: [DRAFT] Athletic throwing base at the completion of the drop — feet positioned to support immediate throwing mechanics. Base width measurable relative to shoulders. Size-independent. Needs motion pipeline.

records.name: QB - Under Center - 3 Step - Drop Depth
records.ideal_execution_standard: Reach the designed three-step depth while maintaining throwing posture — depth allows proper timing and separation from the rush.
records.fault_trigger: Too shallow/deep for the three-step concept. (Absolute depth needs a scale reference.)
records.measurable_signal: [DRAFT — partly RECOMMENDATION] Reach the designed three-step depth with throwing posture — depth allows timing + separation from the rush. Relative depth measurable; absolute needs a scale. Needs motion pipeline.

records.name: QB - Under Center - 3 Step - Drop Rhythm
records.ideal_execution_standard: Maintain consistent timing from snap reception through the final step — smooth, without pauses or rushed movement.
records.fault_trigger: Rushed, paused, or arrhythmic drop tempo.
records.measurable_signal: [DRAFT] Consistent timing from snap through the final step — smooth, no pauses or rushed movement. Tempo/rhythm measurable (the ~1.2-1.4s 3-step signature). Needs motion pipeline.

records.name: QB - Under Center - 3 Step - First Step
records.ideal_execution_standard: Execute a quick, efficient first step in the designed direction — creating proper spacing while maintaining balance and staying ready to throw.
records.fault_trigger: Slow, misdirected, or off-balance first step.
records.measurable_signal: [DRAFT] Quick, efficient first step in the designed direction — proper spacing, balance, body ready to throw. First-step direction/quickness measurable. Needs motion pipeline.

records.name: QB - Under Center - 3 Step - Foot Placement
records.ideal_execution_standard: Feet glide low to the ground throughout the drop — cleats cutting grass, staying in contact so a balanced throwing base is available immediately. The designed crossover step is a FOOT crossing past foot while the knees stay on a linear path; the knees do not cross over one another as in a karaoke drill. Base stays wide enough to hold balance and weight stays centred, not forward on the front foot.
records.fault_trigger: Bouncing, high-stepping, or riding up on the toes instead of gliding. Knees crossing (karaoke-style) rather than the feet gliding past. Base narrowing so the body leans and loses balance. Weight shifting forward onto the front foot, preventing a clean load. Toes pointing backward or knees swinging wide off the linear path. Crossing at a speed that costs control. Heavy heel contact or wasted movement.
records.measurable_signal: [DRAFT] Feet glide low to the ground — low vertical oscillation of the ankles/hips, ground contact maintained, minimal heel contact. The ONE designed crossover is foot crossing past foot; knee separation must be maintained (knees not crossing, karaoke-style). Base width held, weight not forward on the front foot. Glide/bounce, knee separation, base width and crossover detection all measurable. Needs motion pipeline.
records.coaching_cue: Cut grass with your cleats — feet glide, knees don't cross.

records.name: QB - Under Center - 3 Step - Head / Eyes
records.ideal_execution_standard: Maintain vision downfield throughout the drop — head stable while the eyes progress through the defensive coverage. Head stays stable and level over the spine throughout the drop — no bouncing, dipping, or rocking of the upper body, which costs spatial awareness and balance.
records.fault_trigger: Head unstable/bobbing or eyes drop during the drop. (Eye progression not pose-measurable — deferred.) Head bouncing, dipping, or rocking through the drop; upper body unstable, degrading spatial awareness and balance.
records.measurable_signal: [DRAFT — PARTIAL] Vision downfield throughout the drop — head stable while eyes progress through coverage. Head STABILITY/orientation measurable; actual EYE progression = deferred. Partial.

records.name: QB - Under Center - 3 Step - Hip Alignment
records.ideal_execution_standard: Hips remain underneath the body and aligned throughout the drop — maintaining lower-body positioning to generate efficient throwing power. Hips stay loose and mobile through the crossover so weight can transfer cleanly into the throw.
records.fault_trigger: Hips drift out from under the body or misalign during the drop. Back hip locked or tight through the crossover, preventing clean weight transfer.
records.measurable_signal: [DRAFT] Hips under the body + aligned throughout — maintain lower-body positioning for efficient throwing power. Hip-line + position measurable. Needs motion pipeline.

records.name: QB - Under Center - 3 Step - Plant Position
records.ideal_execution_standard: Establish the correct plant position at the top of the drop — feet stop efficiently, allowing immediate transfer into the throwing motion.
records.fault_trigger: No clean plant — feet drift or require extra steps before the throw.
records.measurable_signal: [DRAFT] Correct plant position at the top of the drop — feet stop efficiently, allowing immediate transfer into the throw. Plant-foot detection + timing measurable (key to the 3-step). Needs motion pipeline.

records.name: QB - Under Center - 3 Step - Shoulder Alignment
records.ideal_execution_standard: Shoulders remain controlled and level throughout the drop — avoiding early opening while maintaining the ability to rotate efficiently toward the target. Shoulders stay level and controlled through the drop. The front shoulder neither collapses nor over-rotates — either turns the hips prematurely and blinds vision to one side.
records.fault_trigger: Shoulders open early or tilt during the drop. Shoulders opening to the field too early, letting defenders read the throw instantly. Front shoulder collapsing or over-rotating, turning the hips early and cutting off vision to one side.
records.measurable_signal: [DRAFT] Shoulders controlled + level throughout the drop — avoid opening early, keep the ability to rotate efficiently to the target. Shoulder-line angle + open-timing measurable. Needs motion pipeline.

records.name: QB - Under Center - 3 Step - Stance Transition
records.ideal_execution_standard: Transition from the under-center stance into the drop efficiently after securing the snap — first movement controlled, balanced, and timed with the QB's throwing rhythm.
records.fault_trigger: Slow/unbalanced or mistimed transition from stance into the drop.
records.measurable_signal: [DRAFT] Transition from the under-center stance into the drop efficiently after securing the snap — first movement controlled, balanced, timed with throwing rhythm. Transition timing + balance measurable. Needs motion pipeline.

records.name: QB - Under Center - 3 Step - Step Length
records.ideal_execution_standard: Maintain consistent stride length appropriate for a three-step drop — creating depth without overstriding or losing balance. Stride length stays consistent and matched to the route’s timing — neither over-long nor choppy.
records.fault_trigger: Overstriding or inconsistent stride length, hurting balance. Steps too long or too choppy, so the rhythm of the drop no longer matches the pass route.
records.measurable_signal: [DRAFT] Consistent stride length for a three-step drop — create depth without overstriding or losing balance. Stride length measurable. Needs motion pipeline.

records.name: QB - Under Center - 3 Step - Step Sequence
records.ideal_execution_standard: Complete the correct three-step progression with consistent rhythm — each step building controlled depth while maintaining throwing posture. The drop contains ONE crossover step: the second step crosses to turn the hips toward the target and gain separation, with the third step planting to establish a balanced throwing base.
records.fault_trigger: Wrong step count or inconsistent rhythm through the three steps. Crossover missing, or occurring on the wrong step (it belongs on the second). Steps too long or too choppy so the rhythm no longer matches the route.
records.measurable_signal: [DRAFT] Complete the correct THREE-step progression with consistent rhythm — each step builds controlled depth while keeping throwing posture. Contains ONE crossover, on the second step. Step count, crossover count + position, and rhythm all measurable (this is the signature 3-step timing, ~1.2-1.4s under center). Needs motion pipeline.
records.coaching_cue: Cut grass with your cleats — stay low, don't bounce.

records.name: QB - Under Center - 3 Step - Throwing Platform
records.ideal_execution_standard: Finish the drop in a balanced throwing posture — feet underneath the body, hips loaded, shoulders aligned, and ready to deliver the football. Weight transfers off the back foot into the throw, generating ground force rather than leaving the throw to the arm.
records.fault_trigger: Finishes off-balance or not throwing-ready at the top of the drop. Weight stuck on the back foot at release, so the throw lacks ground force and becomes all arm.
records.measurable_signal: [DRAFT] Finish in a balanced throwing posture — feet under the body, hips loaded, shoulders aligned, ready to deliver. The complete throwing platform measurable from pose. Needs motion pipeline.

records.name: QB - Under Center - 5 Step - Ball Carriage
records.ideal_execution_standard: Maintain two-hand football security from snap reception through the drop — ball tight to the chest with elbows controlled until transitioning into the throwing motion. Both hands stay securely on the ball throughout the drop. Arms and hands stay relaxed but controlled — not stiff, not so loose that the ball drifts and body position goes with it. Hands do not cross the body’s midline.
records.fault_trigger: Ball drops off the chest or elbows flare during the drop. (Ball Position needs ball tracking.) Dropping to one hand on the ball. Arms stiff, or flailing/crossing the body’s midline, forcing the torso to overwork and sapping rotational energy. Ball drifting off a consistent carriage position.
records.measurable_signal: [DRAFT — PROXY] Two-hand ball security from snap through the drop — ball tight to the chest, elbows controlled, until transitioning to the throw. POSE PROXY = hands-together/height/elbow-tuck; Ball Position needs BALL TRACKING. Partial.
records.coaching_cue: Two hands on it — relaxed, not loose.

records.name: QB - Under Center - 5 Step - Base Width
records.ideal_execution_standard: Maintain an athletic throwing base at the completion of the drop — feet underneath the body to support immediate throwing mechanics.
records.fault_trigger: Base too narrow/wide at the top of the drop.
records.measurable_signal: [DRAFT] Athletic throwing base at the completion of the drop — feet under the body to support immediate throwing mechanics. Base width measurable relative to shoulders. Size-independent. Needs motion pipeline.

records.name: QB - Under Center - 5 Step - Drop Depth
records.ideal_execution_standard: Reach the designed five-step depth while maintaining throwing posture — creating proper separation from the line of scrimmage and allowing route development.
records.fault_trigger: Too shallow/deep for the five-step concept. (Absolute depth needs a scale reference.)
records.measurable_signal: [DRAFT — partly RECOMMENDATION] Reach the designed five-step depth with throwing posture — proper separation from the LOS + allows route development. Relative depth measurable; absolute needs a scale. Needs motion pipeline.

records.name: QB - Under Center - 5 Step - Drop Rhythm
records.ideal_execution_standard: Maintain consistent timing from snap reception through the final step — smooth and connected, without rushing or pausing.
records.fault_trigger: Rushed, paused, or disconnected drop tempo.
records.measurable_signal: [DRAFT] Consistent timing from snap through the final step — smooth + connected, no rushing or pausing. Tempo/rhythm measurable (~1.8-2.0s). Needs motion pipeline.

records.name: QB - Under Center - 5 Step - First Step
records.ideal_execution_standard: Execute an efficient first step that creates proper depth while maintaining balance and controlled shoulders — initiating the drop without wasted movement.
records.fault_trigger: Weak/misdirected first step or wasted movement initiating the drop.
records.measurable_signal: [DRAFT] Efficient first step creating depth while keeping balance + shoulders controlled — initiates the drop without wasted movement. First-step measurable. Needs motion pipeline.

records.name: QB - Under Center - 5 Step - Foot Placement
records.ideal_execution_standard: Feet glide low to the ground throughout the drop — cleats cutting grass, staying in contact so a balanced throwing base is available immediately.
